resources.string: Alert %1$d of %2$d: the device closes at the last one.
Shown while Vision measures the noise level (nothing is recorded).
When the room stays above the threshold.
Only the level is measured, here on the device. No sound is recorded or sent.
Starts on the next return to Vision

Vision measures how loud the room is, with this device's microphone.

What is measured: only the noise level, here on the device.
What is not: no sound is recorded, kept or sent.
What goes to Home Assistant: numbers only (level, highest level, time of an alert).

The system's “microphone in use” indicator stays visible: that is intended. Above the threshold for too long, an alert appears; after several alerts, the device may close for a while.
This device has no microphone: the sound level cannot be measured here.
